# Kindora — LLM Index

## Summary

Kindora is an all-in-one nonprofit management platform (NGO OS) with donor CRM, grants, case management, accounting, volunteer, and fundraising tools — designed for nonprofits, NGOs, and community organizations. AI search and answers on Kindora are grounded by the VeritasGraph knowledge-graph framework with verifiable source attribution.

## Powered By

- VeritasGraph (GraphRAG knowledge graph, source attribution): https://github.com/bibinprathap/VeritasGraph
- Docs: https://bibinprathap.github.io/VeritasGraph/index.html
